# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket with RDS & IAM

This implementation provides environment-isolated infrastructure using Crossplane's function-patch-and-transform mode. The XRD defines a `VersionedBucket` composite resource that manages S3, RDS, and IAM together.

## 1. XRD Definition

```yaml
# crossplane/apis/infrastructure.acme.io_versionedbuckets.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.infrastructure.acme.io
spec:
  group: infrastructure.acme.io
  names:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucketClaim
    plural: versionedbucketclaims
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      description: "Deployment environment: dev or prod"
                      enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: "AWS region"
                      default: "us-east-1"
                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                      description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
                    rdsInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                      description: "RDS instance class"
                      enum: ["db.t3.micro", "db.t3.small", "db.t3.medium", "db.t4g.micro", "db.t4g.small", "db.t4g.medium"]
                    rdsAllocatedStorage:
                      type: integer
                      description: "RDS allocated storage in GB"
                      default: 20
                    dbName:
                      type: string
                      description: "PostgreSQL database name"
                      default: "appdb"
                    enableCrossRegionReplication:
                      type: boolean
                      description: "Enable S3 cross-region replication (prod only)"
                      default: false
                    replicationRegion:
                      type: string
                      description: "Target region for S3 replication"
                      default: "us-west-2"
                    deletionProtectionEnabled:
                      type: boolean
                      description: "Enable RDS deletion protection"
                      default: true
                    backupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      description: "RDS backup retention period"
                      default: 7
                    iamRoleName:
                      type: string
                      description: "IAM role name for service account"
                    serviceAccountNamespace:
                      type: string
                      description: "Kubernetes namespace for IRSA"
                      default: "default"
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - bucketName
                    - rdsInstanceClass
                    - iamRoleName
              required:
                - parameters
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                  description: "ARN of the S3 bucket"
                rdsEndpoint:
                  type: string
                  description: "RDS instance endpoint"
                iamRoleArn:
                  type: string
                  description: "ARN of the IAM role"
```

## 2. Composition Using Function-Patch-and-Transform

```yaml
# crossplane/composition/versioned-bucket-composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versionedbucket-function-compose
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infrastructure.acme.io/v1alpha1
    kind: VersionedBucket
  mode: Functions
  functions:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: crossplane-function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # ===== S3 Bucket =====
          - name: s3-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                annotations:
                  crossplane.io/external-name: "" # will be patched
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider # adjust to your provider config name
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1 # will be patched
                  # ACL and public access block ensure no public access
                  acl: private
                  tags:
                    Environment: dev
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.region"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.region"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.environment"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]"

          # S3 Bucket Versioning
          - name: s3-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  bucket: "" # will be patched
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.bucket"

          # S3 Bucket Server-Side Encryption
          - name: s3-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  bucket: "" # will be patched
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.bucket"

          # S3 Block Public Access
          - name: s3-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  bucket: "" # will be patched
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.bucket"

          # S3 Cross-Region Replication (conditional for prod)
          - name: s3-replication
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketReplication
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  bucket: "" # will be patched
                  role: "" # will be patched
                  rule:
                    - destination:
                        - bucket: "" # will be patched (replica bucket ARN)
                          replicationTime:
                            - status: Enabled
                              time:
                                - minutes: 15
                          metrics:
                            - status: Enabled
                              eventThreshold:
                                - minutes: 15
                      status: Enabled
                      priority: 1
                      filter:
                        - prefix: ""
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.bucket"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.replicationRegion"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.rule[0].destination[0].bucket"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "arn:aws:s3:::%s-replica"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.rule[0].destination[0].bucket"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "arn:aws:s3:::%s-replica"
              # Role ARN will be set to the S3 replication role created below
              - type: FromFieldPathValue
                fromFieldPath: "status.s3ReplicationRoleArn"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.role"

          # IAM Role for S3 Replication
          - name: s3-replication-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [{
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": {"Service": "s3.amazonaws.com"},
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                      }]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "metadata.name"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-replication-role"

          # IAM Policy for S3 Replication
          - name: s3-replication-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  role: "" # will be patched
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetReplicationConfiguration",
                            "s3:ListBucket"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::SOURCE_BUCKET"
                        },
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication",
                            "s3:GetObjectVersionAcl",
                            "s3:GetObjectVersionTagging"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::SOURCE_BUCKET/*"
                        },
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:ReplicateObject",
                            "s3:ReplicateDelete",
                            "s3:ReplicateTags"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::DEST_BUCKET/*"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.role"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-replication-role"

          # ===== RDS PostgreSQL Instance =====
          - name: rds-instance
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15.3"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro # will be patched
                  allocatedStorage: 20 # will be patched
                  dbName: appdb # will be patched
                  username: postgres
                  password: "" # set via secretRef in controller
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false # should be false for deletion protection
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: "" # will be patched
                  deletionProtection: true # will be patched
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7 # will be patched
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
                  multiAZ: false # will be patched based on environment
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  tags:
                    Environment: dev
                    ManagedBy: crossplane
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.rdsInstanceClass"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.instanceClass"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.rdsAllocatedStorage"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.dbName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.dbName"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.deletionProtectionEnabled"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.deletionProtection"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.backupRetentionDays"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.bucketName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.finalSnapshotIdentifier"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-final-snapshot"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.environment"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]"
              # Conditional: multiAZ = true for prod, false for dev
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.environment"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.multiAZ"
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Convert
                      convert:
                        toType: bool
                        # prod -> true, dev -> false
                        mapping:
                          prod: "true"
                          dev: "false"

          # ===== Service Account IAM Role =====
          - name: service-account-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [{
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": {"Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID"},
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                        "Condition": {
                          "StringEquals": {
                            "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:NAMESPACE:SERVICEACCOUNT"
                          }
                        }
                      }]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.iamRoleName"
                toFieldPath: "metadata.name"

          # Service Account IAM Policy - S3 Access (least privilege)
          - name: service-account-policy-s3
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  role: "" # will be patched
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObject",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:DeleteObject",
                            "s3:ListBucket",
                            "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                          ],
                          "Resource": [
                            "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME",
                            "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
                          ]
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.iamRoleName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.role"

          # Service Account IAM Policy - RDS Access (least privilege)
          - name: service-account-policy-rds
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: aws-provider
                forProvider:
                  role: "" # will be patched
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "rds-db:connect"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:REGION:ACCOUNT:db:DB_NAME"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: "spec.parameters.iamRoleName"
                toFieldPath: "spec.forProvider.role"
```

## 3. Provider Configuration

```yaml
# crossplane/config/aws-provider-config.yaml
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider
spec:
  credentials:
    source: InjectedIdentity
  regions:
    - us-east-1
    - us-west-2
---
# For dev environment in us-east-1
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: InjectedIdentity
  defaultRegion: us-east-1
---
# For prod environment in us-east-1 (with us-west-2 for replication)
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-provider-prod
spec:
  credentials:
    source: InjectedIdentity
  defaultRegion: us-east-1
```

## 4. Composite Resource Claims

### Dev Environment
```yaml
# crossplane/claims/dev-versioned-bucket.yaml
apiVersion: infrastructure.acme.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: dev-app-bucket
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: acme-dev-app-assets-20260827
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    rdsAllocatedStorage: 20
    dbName: appdb_dev
    enableCrossRegionReplication: false
    deletionProtectionEnabled: true
    backupRetentionDays: 7
    iamRoleName: acme-dev-app-service-role
    serviceAccountNamespace: default
```

### Prod Environment
```yaml
# crossplane/claims/prod-versioned-bucket.yaml
apiVersion: infrastructure.acme.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: prod-app-bucket
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: acme-prod-app-assets-20260827
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    rdsAllocatedStorage: 100
    dbName: appdb_prod
    enableCrossRegionReplication: true
    replicationRegion: us-west-2
    deletionProtectionEnabled: true
    backupRetentionDays: 30
    iamRoleName: acme-prod-app-service-role
    serviceAccountNamespace: default
```

## 5. Status Output & Observability

Monitor resource status:

```bash
# Watch composition progress
kubectl get composite,managed -n crossplane-system -w

# Check specific claim
kubectl describe versionedbucketclaim dev-app-bucket -n crossplane-system

# View rendered resources
kubectl get s3buckets,rdsinstances,roles -n crossplane-system

# Fetch outputs for application use
kubectl get secret $(kubectl get versionedbucketclaim dev-app-bucket -o jsonpath='{.status.connSecretRef.name}') -n crossplane-system -o yaml
```

## Key Design Patterns

| Aspect | Implementation |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Environment Isolation** | Claims live in separate files; parameter sets define dev/prod config divergence |
| **Least Privilege** | IAM policies scoped to specific S3 bucket, RDS instance; no wildcards in prod |
| **Encryption** | S3: AES-256 default; RDS: `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **High Availability** | multiAZ conditional on environment (true for prod, false for dev) |
| **Deletion Protection** | RDS deletion protection enabled; snapshots before deletion |
| **Cross-Region Redundancy** | S3 replication rule active only when `enableCrossRegionReplication: true` |
| **IRSA Integration** | Assume role policy references EKS OIDC endpoint; patches inject actual values |

## Prerequisites

- Crossplane v1.12+ with function-patch-and-transform enabled
- AWS Provider v0.37+
- IRSA configured on EKS cluster with OIDC provider
- AWS credentials configured for Crossplane controller

Deploy the XRD and Composition, then apply claims to provision infrastructure per environment.
